symptoms: Characteristic concentric ring 'target board' dark brown lesions
Yellow chlorotic halos surrounding older lower leaf spots
Progressive upward defoliation from lower canopy to upper foliage
Collar rot lesions at base of stem near soil level
risk_factors: Warm temperatures (24-29°C) alternating with wet and dry cycles
Heavy morning dews and soil splash during rain events
Plant stress from heavy fruit load or nutrient deficiency
prevention: Apply organic mulch around plant base to prevent soil splash
Prune lower foliage (bottom 30 cm) once plants reach 1 meter
Stake or trellis vines upright for enhanced airflow
recommended_actions: Remove lower infected foliage at the first sign of target spots
Apply bio-fungicides or copper sulfate sprays on a 7-10 day interval during wet weather
